title: Ivanka Trump Dazzles in Soft Blue Gown at State Dinner, Creating Family Resemblance Chatter - Photos - NewsBreak
text:
By Roshanak Hannani ,
11 hours ago Ivanka Trump Dazzles in Soft Blue Gown at State Dinner, Creating Family Resemblance Chatter - Photos The first daughter showed up to one of the most formal nights on the White House calendar in a look that had people talking, and one woman's name kept coming up in the online comments.
Ivanka Trump stepped out for the April 28, 2026, State Dinner hosted by President Donald Trump in honor of King Charles III and Queen Camilla's official visit to the United States. The gown was stunning, but it was who fans said she looked like that really got everyone's attention.
The color of Ivanka's dress alone was striking. It was a cool, powdery blue that seemed almost ethereal under formal lighting. Designer Reem Acra created a long-sleeve silhouette structure with a high neckline and a flowing cape-like drape.
Meanwhile, gold sequined embroidery traced the collar, bodice, and cuffs in a way that felt ornate without being overdone, and a sheer overlay at the hem melted into a soft train behind her.
Ivanka's blonde hair fell into loose waves swept behind her ears, and her makeup leaned into soft glam: a smoky eye, a touch of blush, and a glossy lip. Finally, diamond-encrusted stud earrings finished the look.
Of course, the Instagram crowd weighed in quickly, and one comment cut straight to what many were thinking. "Beautiful-looking more like her mother now - wow🔥," wrote one netizen, referring to Ivana Trump , who died in 2022.
Another person. added, "Pure perfection ❤️." A third echoed the sentiment, simply noting she "looks like her late Mother ." Others zeroed in on the dress itself. "She looks good. Love the color of the dress too," one netizen shared.
Over on Facebook , the reactions were just as enthusiastic, with fans calling her "A genie 🧞‍♂️" and one commenter declaring, "Ugh that is a pretty gown! Witchcraft !!"
The comparisons kept coming. "She's got great genes," wrote one fan, while another went a different direction: "Channeling Greek Goddess."
And finally, one person summed up the overall opinion: "She looks lovely! That color is beautiful on her. Very soft and feminine."
